Small and fierce. Real fierce. Come closer - don't be shy.

Category: V. Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 12 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Expansive Ammunition, which for this weapon costs the same as Basic Ammunition. Ammunition purchased for this weapon can only be used by this weapon. When firing at a target within 6m/yds of the user with this weapon and rolling for damage, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
